card.name: Scattered punctuation and spaces in dosing text
card.fires_on: Small connecting spots in label text: a space before a number, a comma in a list, a linking word like by or against, or the middle of a long word. No single word type dominates.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A bare space right before a dose or table number.

modes.label: Comma or abbreviation punctuation
modes.description: A comma or period-comma inside a list or an e.g. phrase in label text.
modes.example: Always have emergency resuscitation drugs<<,>> equipment, and trained personnel available.

modes.label: Linking word
modes.description: A short linking word after a verb or noun, such as by or against.

card.writes: Weakly promotes science words like molecular, atom, radiation and steroid, but the effect is unclear.
card.plain: It fires on small gaps, commas and linking words in drug-label text, with no single theme.
